title: Echeveria subrigida 刚叶莲、钢叶莲

Echeveria subrigida 刚叶莲Synonyms :
异名：Cotyledon subrigida Robinson & Seaton (1893)
Echeveria palmeri Rose (1903)
Echeveria rosei Nelson & Macbride (1913)
Echeveria angusta von Poellnitz (1936)
Series Gibbiflorae
Gibbiflorae系
Distribution : Mexico (México, Hidalgo, San Luis Potosí, Guanajuato, Querétaro)
分布于墨西哥的México州、Hidalgo州、San Luis Potosí州、Guanajuato州、和Querétaro州Description (according to IHSP 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：
Stem usually < 5 cm tall, to 5 cm in diameter, rarely branching.
茎部：通常不超过5cm高，较大直径5cm，很少分枝。
Rosette 15 – 20 cm in diameter.
莲座直径约15-20cm。
Leaves oblong-oblanceolate, acute or shortly acuminate, 15 – 25 x 5 – 10 cm, thick, rigid, margins somewhat upturned and often finely undulate-crenulate, white-pruinose, sometimes nearly or entirely green, margin and mucro reddened.
叶：椭圆形或倒披针形，叶尖处陡然变窄；15-25cm长，2-10cm宽，厚实，坚硬；叶缘略微上翘，而且带有一丝微妙的褶边和细圆齿；被白霜，有时近乎于或完全是绿色的，叶缘和叶尖发红。
Inflorescences 1 - 2, narrowly cymose-paniculate, to 1 m tall, ± 15 mm in diameter near base, to 12-branched, each branch with 1 – 7 flowers, pedicels stout, 2 - 5 mm.
花序：1-2支，稀疏的圆锥聚散花絮，较高1m，基部直径15mm左右，较多12根分枝，每支约1-7朵花；花梗短粗，2-5mm长。
Flowers : Sepals ascending, to 25 mm, corolla urceolate, pentagonal, to 25 mm long, 14 mm in diameter or more near the base, ± 20 mm in diameter at the tip, glaucous, pink to scarlet, nectar scales scarlet.
花：花萼上翘，约25mm；翁状花冠，五角形，约25mm长，14mm直径，基部直径可能更大，顶部直径20mm左右；被霜；粉色或猩红色；蜜腺鳞片（？）猩红色。
Cytology : n = 27, 54
染色体：n=27,54。Note :
请注意：
Until its description in 1997 Echeveria cante erroneously has been distributed as E. subrigida. This means that hybrids with E. subrigida as one parent created prior to 1997 in fact are hybrids with E. cante.
直到1997年，拟石莲属广寒宫一直被误当做拟石莲属刚叶莲。这意味着1997年以前所有以刚叶莲为亲本之一的杂交品种实际上都是广寒宫的后代。
